content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the failure to properly remove a virtual memory area (vma) from the drm_mm (Direct Rendering Manager memory manager) when the binding operation failed. This oversight led to the vma being incorrectly marked as inserted in the drm_mm, which would result in attempts to reinsert it in future operations, causing inconsistencies and potential memory management issues. The patch addresses this by ensuring that the vma is removed from the drm_mm if the binding fails, thus maintaining the integrity of the memory management system.
